meta.name: perf-benchmarker
meta.description: Use when running performance benchmarks, establishing baselines, or validating regressions with sequential runs. Enforces 60s minimum runs (30s only for binary search) and no parallel benchmarks.

copy.tagline: 运行性能基准测试并检测回归
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码变更后确认性能没有下降
copy.tagline_en: Run performance benchmarks and detect regressions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to confirm no performance degradation after code changes

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会按顺序运行性能基准测试，每次至少 60 秒（二分查找时 30 秒），并输出 JSON 格式的指标。
howto.when: 当你要求运行性能基准测试、建立基线或验证回归时触发。

say.text: 帮我跑一下这个命令的性能基准测试
say.note: Claude 会按规则运行并输出结果。

say.text: 对当前代码做性能基线测试，持续 60 秒
say.note: Claude 会执行 60 秒基准测试。

howto.what_en: Claude runs sequential performance benchmarks with a minimum of 60s per run (30s for binary search) and outputs JSON metrics.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to run performance benchmarks, establish baselines, or validate regressions.

say_en.text: Run a performance benchmark for this command.
say_en.note: Claude will run it with strict duration rules.

say_en.text: Establish a performance baseline for the current code.
